framing: Annual reported death counts by road-user type
can_answer: yes — the file has crash-level counts of motorist and cyclist deaths and crash dates for 2013–2025.
metric: Sum of number_of_motorist_killed and number_of_cyclist_killed separately for each calendar year.
denominator: None; these are annual reported death counts, not rates.
population: All crash records in NYC with crash_date in calendar years 2013–2025; each crash contributes its recorded count for each type.
filters: Keep crash_date years 2013 through 2025 inclusive; no borough filter because the file is NYC crashes.
grouping: Calendar year and road-user type (motorist, cyclist).
chart_type: Two-series line chart of annual counts.
data_check_meaning_and_decisions: The checked population contains 2,132,218 crash rows across 2013–2025. Each of the 13 years has observed dates from Jan 1 through Dec 31; this confirms boundary coverage but not that every record is present. In the selected population, crash_date has 0 missing/impossible/default dates and number_of_motorist_killed and number_of_cyclist_killed each have 0 missing values. Missing dates cannot be assigned to the requested years and are excluded by the year filter; no selected rows are dropped or assigned differently for missing death values. Decision: keep all selected rows and sum the recorded death counts; disclose that these are reported totals, not exposure-adjusted rates, and date boundaries do not prove complete reporting.
limitations: The measures are totals of reported crash-level death counts, not population or traffic-exposure rates. The date range spans each full calendar year's boundaries, but the check cannot establish completeness within those years.
